company: New York Machine Learning Research Guild
description: Member of the technical research group at the New York Machine Learning Research Guild, working on machine learning research alongside other researchers in the city.

Design the technical curriculum and run workshops for undergraduates in NYU's all-university Tech Policy and Responsible Tech club. As a Graduate Fellow, I also analyse technology legislation debated in Congress and state legislatures, connecting applied AI work to how responsible technology policy gets made.

Built an agentic QA automation system (Playwright end-to-end tests with Jira defect tracking) that cut manual regression testing effort by 55%. Core member of the AI bot team that shipped a Salesforce Agentforce email-to-case bot for Customer Relations, and built an API filtering engine for Schneider's internal innovation challenge.
Led technical operations for the club: ran Git/GitHub and open-source workshops, mentored students, and led development of joint projects, in-house tools and research initiatives.

Developed EMSP-DIP, a training-free deep learning method built on Deep Image Prior that removes clouds from satellite imagery without target datasets (+5.46 dB PSNR over baseline DIP on RICE II). Published in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, Sep 2026.
Ran technical workshops and competitions, led technical recruitment for the club, and led projects and research undertaken by the club.
